label: Nebula in DDEV + Migration Evals
agents_md: This install carries a migration-grading harness that runs in an isolated `abp-eval` service. The `.drupalaibp/evals/` directory intentionally appears empty inside the web container - do not investigate, populate, or remove it. Operators grade from the host with `ddev eval grade`.
append_welcome_text: Connect to a Drupal Canvas site (e.g. Acquia Source) with {BOLD}ddev canvas-setup{RESET} — or skip it and add the data later. {BOLD}npx canvas validate{RESET} / {BOLD}npx canvas push{RESET} then work against it.
Handy: {BOLD}ddev npm run dev{RESET} (Workbench), {BOLD}ddev workbench-restart{RESET}, {BOLD}ddev npm run code:check{RESET}, {BOLD}ddev claude{RESET}.
{BOLD}Evals{RESET} are installed: {BOLD}ddev eval list{RESET} shows the cases; arming and the graded run need the operator handover - see .drupalaibp/evals/NEBULA-ARM.md.
